rationale: A is better structured around complete count phrases, which keeps lyric construction concise and centralizes the zero and singular/plural cases. It is also more robust beyond the tested 0–10 range because unknown counts fall back to decimal text, whereas B's map lookup can produce an empty string and make capitalize panic. A's capitalize comment inaccurately refers to runes despite byte slicing, but with these ASCII phrases that does not affect behavior and is outweighed by its safer handling and clearer decomposition.
